cases.purpose: Malformed ping targets fail with status 1 and a diagnostic, and a seccomp user-notification log of the candidate shell records no socket, connect, bind, listen or sendto call, no new UDP/TCP socket appears and the state directory is unchanged; a valid-endpoint ping to a closed port is the positive control.
cases.oracle: Loopback UDP membership source contract: a ping whose target is neither 127.0.0.1:PORT nor a known node fails in bc_contact() before bc_socket(), so no socket(2), bind, connect, sendto or listen call is made. The observer is a seccomp user-notification listener (log and continue; no kill filter) installed around a fresh candidate shell, with a valid-endpoint ping to a closed port as the positive control that the same filter records socket and sendto calls, and /proc/net socket tables and the state directory as kernel-side before/after comparisons.
cases.comparison: Exact expectation for status and output derived from the cluster source contract and kernel socket tables; the notification log is raw diagnostic evidence.
cases.script:
guard_guest() {
  local token vendor virt inside outside length extra
  local -a uid_rows
  [[ -r /etc/bashos-parity-vm && -r /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || return 125
  IFS= read -r token </etc/bashos-parity-vm || return 125
  IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || return 125
  [[ $vendor == QEMU && $token =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || return 125
  (( UID == EUID )) || return 125
  if (( EUID == 0 )); then
    mapfile -t uid_rows </proc/self/uid_map || return 125
    (( ${#uid_rows[@]} == 1 )) || return 125
    read -r inside outside length extra <<<"${uid_rows[0]}" || return 125
    [[ $inside == 0 && $outside == 2000 && $length == 1 && -z $extra ]] || return 125
  else
    (( EUID == 2000 )) || return 125
  fi
  virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || return 125
  [[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || return 125
}
guard_guest || { printf 'refusing non-fixture guest\n' >&2; exit 125; }
[[ $(type -t cluster) == builtin ]] || exit 99
SS=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-sequence.py
PORT=47311; CLOSED=47399
export BASHCLUSTER_STATE_DIR=$PWD/state
printf 'abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab\n' > key
cluster init -p $PORT -k key >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "init rc=$?"
snap() { local f; for f in "$BASHCLUSTER_STATE_DIR"/*; do [[ -e $f ]] || continue; printf '%s %s\n' "${f##*/}" "$(/usr/bin/cksum < "$f")"; done | /usr/bin/sort; }
udp() { /usr/bin/awk 'NR>1{print $2}' /proc/net/udp | /usr/bin/sort | /usr/bin/tr '\n' ','; }
tcp() { /usr/bin/awk 'NR>1{print $2,$4}' /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/sort | /usr/bin/tr '\n' ','; }
snap > before.snap; udp > before.udp; tcp > before.tcp
echo "listener-udp-row=$([[ $(< before.udp) == *":$(printf '%04X' $PORT)"* ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
NET=(--notify socket --notify connect --notify sendto --notify sendmmsg --notify bind --notify listen --notify accept --notify accept4 --log-args socket=0,1 --log-args sendto=0)
obs() { # label script args...
  local l=$1 s=$2; shift 2
  : > "$PWD/log-$l"
  BASHCLUSTER_TIMEOUT_MS=50 /usr/bin/python3 "$SS" "${NET[@]}" --log "$PWD/log-$l" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$s" _ "$@"
}
sig() { /usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import sys,json
rows=[]
for l in open(sys.argv[1]):
    r=json.loads(l); rows.append("%s:%s:%s" % (r["syscall"], r.get("arg0","-"), (r["arg1"] & 0xf) if "arg1" in r else "-"))
print(",".join(sorted(rows)))' "$1"; }
inet() { /usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import sys,json
n=0
for l in open(sys.argv[1]):
    r=json.loads(l)
    if r["syscall"] in ("sendto","bind","listen","sendmmsg","accept","accept4") or (r["syscall"]=="socket" and r.get("arg0")!=1): n+=1
print(n)' "$1"; }
count() { /usr/bin/grep -c "\"syscall\": \"$2\"" "$PWD/log-$1"; }
obs base 'n=0; for f in /proc/$BASHPID/fd/*; do [[ -S $f ]] && n=$((n+1)); done; echo "inherited-sockets=$n"; :'
echo "baseline inet-or-send-calls=$(inet "$PWD/log-base")"
i=0
for t in 'localhost:5000' '127.0.0.1:0' '127.0.0.1:65536' '127.0.0.1:abc' '127.0.0.1:' '10.0.0.1:5000' 'no-such-node'; do
  i=$((i+1))
  out=$(obs t$i '[[ $(type -t cluster) == builtin ]] || exit 99; cluster ping "$1" 2>&1; exit $?' "$t"); rc=$?
  echo "target[$t] rc=$rc same-as-baseline=$([[ $(sig "$PWD/log-t$i") == "$(sig "$PWD/log-base")" ]] && echo yes || echo no) inet-or-send-calls=$(inet "$PWD/log-t$i") diag=$out"
done
out=$(obs ctl 'cluster ping "127.0.0.1:'$CLOSED'" 2>&1; exit $?'); rc=$?
echo "control rc=$rc diag=$out inet-or-send-calls=$(inet "$PWD/log-ctl") sendto=$(count ctl sendto) bind=$(count ctl bind) listen=$(count ctl listen)"
echo "control-dgram-socket=$(sig "$PWD/log-ctl" | /usr/bin/grep -o 'socket:2:2' | /usr/bin/wc -l)"
snap > after.snap; udp > after.udp; tcp > after.tcp
/usr/bin/cmp -s before.snap after.snap && echo state-unchanged=yes || echo state-unchanged=NO
/usr/bin/cmp -s before.udp after.udp && echo udp-unchanged=yes || echo udp-unchanged=NO
/usr/bin/cmp -s before.tcp after.tcp && echo tcp-unchanged=yes || echo tcp-unchanged=NO
cluster status | /usr/bin/sed -n 's/^state=/state=/p;s/^port=/port=/p'
echo "leave: $(cluster leave 2>&1)"

listener-udp-row=yes
